notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Flush Queue Request service to source-derived clauses 8.12 and 8.12.3. The embedded profile flushes the currently queued in-process TSO payloads, records the accepted supplied logical-time boundary with Table 5 LogicalTime representation before the later Flush Queue Grant, computes that callback grant as the minimum of the supplied request, the current GALT when available, and the earliest undelivered timestamp, and retains the optimistic logical-time floor. A timestamped non-regional attribute-update companion now exercises the same delivery, actual-grant, and optimistic-floor rules for object passels. Regional explicit-source and default-source interaction companions use committed overlap, deliver the timestamped callback before FQG, and verify the conveyed source-region set (including the supplied-empty marker for the private default source) plus actual/optimistic values. A default-source timestamped attribute-update companion now drives one ordinary/default-region passel through FQR, TARA, and NMRA and proves callback-before-grant ordering with the supplied-empty region marker. A mixed-member regional companion sends one overlap-qualified TSO payload to FQR, TARA, and NMRA recipients and proves each callback frontier independently before its grant. A separate HLA_EVOKED future-input companion accepts FQR first, submits two timestamped interactions before callback dispatch, and proves both callbacks precede FQG; these are in-process callback-frontier cases, not remote transport evidence. Its shared actual-grant calculation now also feeds the separately traced timestamped-save admission seam: queued TSO is delivered, a direct Initiate Federate Save is permitted only when the actual Flush Queue Grant is strictly later than the save time, and the private time state changes only before the subsequent Flush Queue Grant callback. The all-mode timestamped-save case combines that strict FQR branch with TAR, NMR, TARA, and NMRA before non-time-constrained notification. A paired live-record restore regression uses FQR to cross a restored recipient's callback boundary while preserving the producer's retraction lower bound; paired single-member HLA_EVOKED/HLA_IMMEDIATE regressions snapshot a still-pending FQR and prove the fresh restored FQG follows Federation Restored. Neither establishes general save/restore behavior. Future transport arrivals, in-transit network coordination beyond the pure grant frontier, Request Retraction behavior outside normal timestamped Send Interaction, package/catalog evidence, protected review, and conformance remain outside this slice.
